hero.headline: From script to final cut
hero.support: An AI workbench for short drama and comic-video: parse text, build characters and scenes, board shots, dub, and export.

workflow.title: One production pipeline
workflow.subtitle: Move in creative order. Review and rerun each step—no single black-box render.

analyze.title: Text analysis
analyze.description: Import a novel or draft script; extract characters, scenes, conflict, and dialogue structure.

assets.title: Characters & scenes
assets.description: Generate reusable people and locations so later shots share the same look and space.

board.title: Storyboard
board.description: Turn text into boards; tune pacing, framing, and prompts before generating frames.

produce.title: Voice & export
produce.description: Multi-character dubbing and shot synthesis, then export a publishable cut.

features.title: Workbench capabilities
features.subtitle: Focus on the costly parts of short-form production: consistent assets, controllable boards, voice, and export.

character.title: Character workshop
character.description: Define cast and generate looks that stay consistent across shots.

world.title: Scene building
world.description: Generate locations per scene as stable spatial references for boards.

storyboard.title: Smart storyboard
storyboard.description: Lay out shots from text; edit prompts and rerun a single shot without restarting the episode.

voice.title: Voice & export
voice.description: Multi-character speech synthesis, then combine with picture and export.

script.title: Script analysis
script.description: Auto-detect cast, locations, and plot beats to cut manual breakdown work.

assets.title: Asset hub
assets.description: Keep characters, scenes, and props in one place; reuse them across projects.

useCases.title: Who it’s for
useCases.subtitle: Creators and small teams who need to move text into watchable picture quickly.

shortDrama.title: Short-drama previews
shortDrama.description: Run boards and voice first to test pacing before heavy polish.

comic.title: Comic-video adaptation
comic.description: Pull cast and boards from a novel or outline to shorten early prep.

team.title: Small-team workflow
team.description: Keep assets and shots in one workbench instead of scattered drives and chats.

open.title: Open source & self-host
open.description: Deploy locally or privately; keep keys and media on your own stack.

locale.title: Bilingual UI
locale.description: Switch Simplified Chinese / English in one click for mixed teams.

iterate.title: Rerun by step
iterate.description: Rerun character, board, or voice jobs without resetting the whole pipeline.

cta.title: Start with your first project
cta.subtitle: Sign up, open the workbench, and try analysis and boards on your own text.

story.label: Story
story.body: Pull lead, antagonist, and core conflict from text before building assets.

script.label: Script
script.body: Break into runnable scenes: locations, entrances, and dialogue lines for boarding.

storyboard.label: Storyboard
storyboard.body: Generate per-shot prompts; rerun one shot without resetting the episode.

output.label: Final cut
output.body: Lay multi-character voice on the timeline, compose video, then export.
